description: This file defines a Flutter widget class 'PaymentFragment' that provides a user interface for selecting and initiating different payment methods including Wallet, QR Pay, Paytm, Mobikwik, and Google Pay, with functionality to deep link launch these applications and confirm payment status through dialog prompts.

classes.name: PaymentFragment
classes.description: A stateless widget that displays payment options and handles user interactions for payment activities.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs the widget tree for the payment fragment screen, including UI elements and interaction handlers.

methods.name: _buildPaymentTile
methods.description: Helper method to create a card widget for each payment method, with icon, name, and tap handler.

methods.name: _launchApp
methods.description: Attempts to launch an external app via URL scheme, shows fallback message if unsuccessful.

methods.name: _showPaymentDialog
methods.description: Displays a confirmation dialog for completing the payment transaction.
